scope: Geometry-derived validation-scene launch proposals only; no model predictions, training, physical simulation or future route outcomes consulted. Existing arenas and assets unchanged. These are diagnostic validation scenarios, not an untouched benchmark.
applicable_instructions: No filesystem AGENTS.md found in checkout/ancestors or checkout recursive file listing; supplied user instruction requests concise intuitive answers. Work restricted to isolated worktree.

selection_protocol.scenes_considered: Read layouts for six validation scenes; selected mixed_obstacles as primary for11assets, rough_mosaic and rolling_hills as terrain-family support. Search used only these three BMPs and their asset geometry.
selection_protocol.grid: For each rock center, initial reference at16/20/24m along24 headings (0..345deg step15); initialproposalgoal44m along same heading.
selection_protocol.guards: Start and goal coordinate magnitudes<=104m; conservative initial6x3m asset clearance>=4m; footprint height range<=0.30m; sampled maxgrade<=6deg; fittedplane residual<=0.10m; goal circumscribed-asset clearance>=4m.
selection_protocol.ranking: Maximize count of assets5..42m forward within±15m; then maximize count10..32m forward within±10m; then prefer distance20m; then smaller footprint height range, smaller maxgrade, smaller targetindex, smaller heading.
selection_protocol.outcome_independence: Only authored case/layout/BMP/source files opened for this choice. No existing trajectory/contact/status/risk/model score files were used.
selection_protocol.v2_goal_override: After geometry-only start selection, extend all goals to84m on same heading. Validate all21predeclared curves with no asset/terrain filter.

records.nominal_time_caveat: Distance/speed only; from-rest acceleration and terrain can delay arrival. This is not an FDM or Chrono outcome prediction.

initial_footprint_geometry.method: TerrainMap bilinear height and interpolated quantized-grid gradient; not native Chrono triangle/settling result
initial_footprint_geometry.asset_clearance_method: Euclidean distance from each asset center to oriented 6x3m start rectangle minus authored circumscribed footprint radius; positive margin proves no 2D overlap under this envelope

Replace old settle_reference with a new valid reference from this start to this goal
Update diagnostic collection contract to exactly 12s; do not inherit 180s cap or stop early on goal if exact horizon is required
Render a fresh observation after the common 0.8s settle and use its actual settled pose/state for all four routes
Use AMD settle-only initialization check before model scoring; reject initial overlap or unstable settlement by predeclared geometry/start-state criteria, never route outcomes
